defective_pattern: Applying bold font weight to Persian table captions.
why_defective: Violates explicit user typography standards which mandate 12pt B Nazanin Regular (non-bold) for all table captions.
observed_symptoms: <w:b/> or <w:bCs/> tags found in table caption runs
corrective_remedy: Remove bold weight from table captions. Ensure font is B Nazanin, size 12 pt, Regular.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of bold styling applied to paragraph styles or runs explicitly acting as Table Captions.
